source.author: verg
source.text: Interea reges, ingenti mole Latinus quadriiugo vehitur curru, cui tempora circum aurati bis sex radii fulgentia cingunt, Solis avi specimen; bigis it Turnus in albis, bina manu lato crispans hastilia ferro; hinc pater Aeneas, Romanae stirpis origo, sidereo flagrans clipeo et caelestibus armis, et iuxta Ascanius, magnae spes altera Romae, procedunt castris, puraque in veste sacerdos saetigeri fetum suis intonsamque bidentem attulit admovitque pecus flagrantibus aris.
source.text_original: Interea reges, ingenti mole Latinus / quadriiugo vehitur curru, cui tempora circum / aurati bis sex radii fulgentia cingunt, / Solis avi specimen; bigis it Turnus in albis, / bina manu lato crispans hastilia ferro; / hinc pater Aeneas, Romanae stirpis origo, / sidereo flagrans clipeo et caelestibus armis, / et iuxta Ascanius, magnae spes altera Romae, / procedunt castris, puraque in veste sacerdos / saetigeri fetum suis intonsamque bidentem / attulit admovitque pecus flagrantibus aris.
source.text_english: Meanwhile the kings advance: Latinus is carried in a huge four-horse chariot, around whose temples gleam twelve shining golden rays, an image of his grandfather Sol; Turnus rides in a pair of white horses, brandishing in either hand broad spears with iron points; on one side Father Aeneas, source of the Roman line, blazing with his starry shield and heavenly armor, and beside him Ascanius, the other great hope of Rome, come forth from the camp, and in pure vesture the priest brought and set near the blazing altars the offspring of a bristly sow and a woolly ewe unshorn.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: flagrantes aras vestemque nemusque sacerdos praecipitat, subitisque pavens circumspicit Aeson, quid moveat.
reuse.text_original: flagrantes aras vestemque nemusque sacerdos / praecipitat, subitisque pavens circumspicit Aeson, / quid moveat.
reuse.text_english: The priest hurled down the blazing altars, his robe, and the grove, and Ae son, trembling, looked around to see what he might do in the sudden crisis.
